title: chaerophyllum hirsutum var. alpestre
intro: Chaerophyllum hirsutum var. alpestre, commonly known as Mountain Parsley, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Parsley include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. Its bioactive constituents include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
